entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [wasm][coreclr] Bring WBT tests on coreclr, make a few non-workload WBT tests work #120647
    11.0.0
  • [wasm][coreclr] cDAC support #120646
    11.0.0
  • Create Linux build images for .NET 11 #120645

Closed

  • Generating VisualStudio project does not work after updating to VS 2026 #120578
  • [wasm coreclr] document how to build coreclr on wasm #113885
    Future
  • Remove private reflection from DependencyModel #3657
  • [wasm][coreclr] fix resources lookup #120318
    Future
  • Add unit test for issue #7346 (custom attribute constructor crash on null array of enums) #18847
    Future
  • BitOperationsTests has broken coverage for nuint #120356

PullRequests

Created

  • Replace UIntPtr with nuint on managed JIT/EE interface #120648
    area-crossgen2-coreclr

Merged

  • Replace Marshal.AllocHGlobal with NativeMemory.Alloc in cross-platform code #120630
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices
  • Add support for using CMake's VS 2026 generator #120580
    area-Infrastructure
  • Fix build breaks with clang 21 #120644
    area-System.Security
  • [wasm][coreclr] Fix arg iterator offset calculation and EH in part of interpreter tests #120613
    arch-wasm, area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [release/9.0-staging] [mono][sgen] Fix incorrect condition when checking if we should do a major collection #120533
    Servicing-approved, area-GC-mono
  • [release/9.0-staging] [mono][interp] Fix various leaks, primarily around dynamic methods #120600
    Servicing-approved, area-VM-meta-mono
  • Add unit test for issue #7346 (custom attribute constructor crash on null array of enums) #120641
    area-System.Reflection, test-enhancement
  • Fix missing nuint casts in BitOperationsTests #120361
    area-System.Runtime

Updated

  • Use Windows BCrypt for Sha1ForNonSecretPurposes instead of managed implementation #120633
    area-System.Runtime, tenet-performance
  • [browser] build browserhost in host.native subset #120298
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Propagate regex comments to source-generated code #120629
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • Add comprehensive tests for problematic filename characters in System.IO #120639
    area-System.IO, test-enhancement
  • Support IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object/JsonElement> as JsonExtensionData #120636
    area-System.Text.Json
  • Improve code coverage for CanonicalXmlEntityReference class (0% → 92.8%) #120640
    area-System.Security, test-enhancement
  • Add hexadecimal float/double parsing and formatting support (IEEE 754:2008) #120637
    area-System.Runtime
  • Disable FileStream buffering when used with StreamReader/StreamWriter to eliminate double buffering #120631
    area-System.IO
  • Add Vector512/Vector256 SIMD acceleration to UTF-8 utility functions #120628
    area-System.Runtime, tenet-performance
  • Remove usage of `Precode::GetPrecodeFromEntryPoint` in WASM. #120583
    arch-wasm, area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Add comprehensive unit tests for Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting projects #120632
    test-enhancement, area-Extensions-Hosting
  • Update Regex named blocks from Unicode 4.0 to Unicode 16.0 #120623
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • Update BitArray.CopyTo to use cross-platform intrinsics #120627
    area-System.Collections
  • [iOS] Implement IgnoreSymbols for CompreInfo in managed code #120462
    area-System.Globalization, os-ios, 11.0.0
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #120556
    area-codeflow
  • Remove Socket.SendFile 2GB limitation on Windows by partitioning large files #120634
    area-System.Net.Sockets
